expectations.text: The close-out carries no guilt, no manufactured deadline pressure, and is not a further touch disguised as a goodbye.
expectations.evidence: The draft itself avoids guilt ('If the timing doesn't work, no problem'). The close-out still fails on two counts. First, the response tells the user to set an artificial reply-by date of the 20th even though the program actually closes on the 25th. That is a manufactured, earlier deadline. Second, Note 3 says to send 'one last two-line note' ('Last check before we finalize on the 25th. Should I release the slot?').
